**Profit Margin Analyzer v1.0.1 Changelog**

- Added a quick reference decision matrix to benchmark analysis quality (cost data completeness, fee mapping, ad spend attribution, etc.)
- Expanded workflow section with detailed step-by-step methodology for building per-SKU margin waterfalls and identifying margin leaks
- Enhanced solution coverage, including multi-channel profitability, channel-specific cost mapping, and advertising cost integration
- Introduced margin performance tiering and Pareto analysis in margin distribution section
- Added 4 new reference documents: margin optimization playbook, cost structure guide, output template, and quality checklist
